fn derivative(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((not (len(xs) <= 1)) or (result == []))
  ensures ((not (len(xs) > 1)) or ((len(result) == (len(xs) - 1)) and (forall j in 0..len(result): (result[j] == ((j + 1) * xs[(j + 1)])))))
  ensures (len(result) == (if (len(xs) <= 1) then 0 else (len(xs) - 1)))
  effects pure
  example (derivative([]) == [])
{
  []
}
